article.headline: ‘Gangs of London’ Producers Claim They’re Owed $20 Million From Vice Over Pulse Films Sale
article.summary: The founders of “Gangs of London” producer Pulse Films claim they are owed more than $20 million over the sale of the studio to Vice Media in 2021. Thomas Benski and Marisa Clifford, who founded Pulse Films in 2005, allege Vice still owes them $20.43 million after acquiring their 22% stake in the company for […]
